name: binary-cube-subcube-corruption-tools

tools.name: binary_cube_run_subcube_corruption_matrix
tools.description: Test strict and bounded-tolerant subcube decoding against single/multiple, contiguous/dispersed, complete-region, and adversarial share corruption, then independently verify each decoded result with the experimental keyed integrity artifact. Distinguishes corrected recovery, rejected wrong recovery, and any critical verified-wrong result.

integrityKey.description: Experimental integrity key used only to independently verify recovered plaintext.

tools.name: binary_cube_compare_subcube_corruption
tools.description: Run the integrity-aware share-corruption matrix across fan-outs 1, 3, 5, and 7 using safe correction limits per fan-out.

securityNote: The integrity primitive is experimental and is not a standardized MAC or production cryptographic authentication mechanism.
